implementation_clarification_before_outc.historical_role_rule: Conservatively treat any historical non-training-role source-frame overlap as unresolved, with exact-point and floor64px-crop subsets reported separately.
implementation_clarification_before_outc.coverage_reporting: Report raw producer-relative and historical-role-screened three-category coverage separately.
implementation_clarification_before_outc.future_design_eligibility: Both raw and role-screened coverage gates must pass, plus at least one useful new exact point outside unresolved historical source frames.
implementation_clarification_before_outc.failure_interpretation: Role failure blocks transfer design pending role resolution; it is not evidence that raw scientific coverage is absent or that earlier accepted fitting was improper.

audit_limit: Saved means/extraction, channel digests and contributor identities are audited. Discarded raw forward channel values cannot be numerically averaged again postrun; unchanged reduction is validated by meaningful float32/order synthetic tests.
